This name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, representing the blessings bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Ilyasa carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ilyasa usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
